en.answer: Even if the monster targeted by <<14412>> is in face-down Defense Position when its effect resolves, the effect is applied normally. In this scenario, if the targeted <<14407>> returns to face-up Attack Position this turn, it can attack twice during each Battle Phase, and when it does your opponent will not be able to activate Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step.
en.question: I activate <<14412>>, targeting a face-up <<14407>> in my Monster Zone. If my opponent chains <<5432>> and changes <<14407>> to face-down Defense Position, how does <<14412>> resolve?
